ops.title: hunks.go's jj lane newline-splits jj diff output
ops.description:
`internal/cli/hunks.go` `changedFiles` splits jj's `diff --name-only` output on
newlines, so a filename CONTAINING a newline would split into two bogus paths.

Left deliberately when the git half of the same bug class was fixed
(2026-08-03): jj offers no `-z` for `diff --name-only`, and measured against jj
0.43.0, jj emits paths verbatim and unquoted — a file named
`we<U+200D>id"name.txt` and one named ` lead.txt` both print raw, unlike git,
which C-quotes the first. The reachable half of the defect (a `TrimSpace` that
ate leading/trailing whitespace and mangled git's C-quoted names, making a dirty
file vanish silently from `ccx vcs hunks`) IS fixed.

Revisit if a future jj grows a NUL-framed name listing.

ops.text: Either jj gains a NUL-framed name listing and changedFiles adopts it, or the newline split carries a comment recording why it is safe
